draft.subject: Checking on the Junior Engineer, Product Infrastructure posting
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, a recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. I came across NIKSUN's Junior Engineer, Product Infrastructure posting and wanted to reach out directly, since it appears to have been open for over 30 days and I wasn't sure if it's still actively being filled.

My background includes hands-on C/C++ systems work: I built distributed MPI pipelines achieving up to 30x speedup through custom work-distribution scheduling across multiple parallel strategies, and a separate MPI-based simulation achieving a 10.49x speedup across 12 worker processes on a SLURM-managed cluster. I've also architected multi-stage processing pipelines with custom memory management and concurrency in a prior research role, improving output quality from a PSNR of 65 to 86.

If the role has already been filled or closed, I'd appreciate knowing whether there's another opening at NIKSUN that might suit my C/C++, Linux, and performance-engineering background -- your recruiting background made you a natural person to ask.

I'd welcome the chance to connect briefly and share my resume, whichever way this goes.
draft.hook_used: Recruiter role at the company posting the role -- asking directly about posting status and fit
